Description
US 90% Silver Coins – Pre-1965 Roosevelt Dime Design (Junk Silver) 50 pieces
The coins consist of .900 silver and .100 copper, and were minted in Philadelphia, Denver, San Francisco, and West Point.
The coins you receive will be a random year.
Design of the 50 Silver Roosevelt Dimes .900 Silver
The 90% Silver Roosevelt Dimes collection allows numismatists and collectors to own a set of these historic coins, showcasing the enduring design and historical significance of the Roosevelt dime series. The 90% Silver Roosevelt Dimes refer to a collection of five different Roosevelt dimes, each minted in .900 fine silver.
The design of the 90% Silver Roosevelt Dimes features a left-facing profile of President Franklin D. Roosevelt on the obverse. This portrait was created by John R. Sinnock and is surrounded by the inscriptions “LIBERTY” above the President’s head and the motto “IN GOD WE TRUST” to the right. The year of mintage is located below the President’s portrait. On the reverse, the dime showcases a torch, an olive branch, and an oak branch. The torch symbolizes liberty, while the olive branch represents peace and the oak branch symbolizes strength and independence. Encircling these symbols are the words “UNITED STATES OF AMERICA” and “E PLURIBUS UNUM.” The denomination “ONE DIME” is placed at the bottom of the reverse. The design of the Roosevelt dime remains largely unchanged since its introduction in 1946, making it a familiar and beloved coin among collectors and the general public. The image of President Roosevelt on the obverse and the powerful symbolism on the reverse capture the spirit and values of the United States, making the 90% Silver Roosevelt Dimes a significant and cherished set in numismatic history.
Main Highlights of the 50 Silver Roosevelt Dimes .900 Silver
The Silver Roosevelt Dimes from 1946 to 1964 are struck in highly pure 90% fine silver. Each dime contains 2.5 grams of silver.
50 coins contains approximately 4 Troy oz of silver
$5 face value (50 coins 10 cents each)
There can be any number  of different years in each batch, with different styles & mints. Common dimes as well as Doubled Die & Dates with blunt or pointed ends.
